summary: Provider refreshes are generation-fenced, abortable, time-limited, and clear failed or empty states with regression coverage.

evidence: static/admin-supervisor.js adds refresh generation checks, per-refresh abort controllers, and a 14-second timeout for both provider requests.
static/admin-supervisor.js clears unavailable and empty-provider responses, while the added tests cover failures, out-of-order completion, and timeout behavior.
